lead.headline: Daniels needs 36 tonight; Jacobs unlikely Wednesday
lead.deck: 77.9 to 114.04 with only Daniels left. ESPN: 3%.
lead.body: Bad news first: Tuten, your FLEX, re-aggravated his ankle and scored 8.3 while Rice scored 11.3 on the bench; Likely had 4.5. KEI returns are final at 114.04. Daniels, full in practice all week, plays Cincinnati tonight and needs 36.14; his best game this season is 29.8. For Week 12, LaFleur called Jacobs unlikely for Wednesday's Rams game, Ryans said Marks is trending toward Sunday, and Coen called Tuten's re-check 'not too bad'. Taylor gets Anthony Richardson Sr. at quarterback.
